toegepas.na: oor die huis wat ver weg is
toegepas.rede_vinder: The bare postposed 'ver weg' reads clipped and poetic; a relative clause is clearer at Grade 6.
toegepas.fout: 'die huis ver weg' is a clipped, English-shaped postposed phrase ('home far away') that reads poetic rather than plain in a Grade 6 study text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The relative clause is the natural plain Afrikaans form, keeps the same meaning, and costs only two words within the ceiling.

toegepas.voor: Isicathamiya is 'n hele koor met net stemme en 'n voorsanger.
toegepas.na: In isicathamiya sing 'n hele koor en 'n voorsanger met net hul stemme.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A music style is not a choir, and 'net stemme en 'n voorsanger' wrongly sets the lead singer apart from the voices; this also matches the next sentence's 'In maskandi speel...'.
toegepas.fout: The original says the music style is a choir, and 'met net stemme en 'n voorsanger' can read as if the lead singer is something other than a voice.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal keeps the same people and facts (whole choir, lead singer, voices only), fixes the category slip, and mirrors the next sentence's 'In maskandi speel...'.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: no comma before 'en' when it joins two phrases rather than two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: A comma before 'en' joining two phrases that are not clauses with their own subject and verb, against the AWS 2017 and the house comma rule.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain punctuation fix that changes no word of the definition, leaves the protected opening intact, and keeps both qualifiers 'dikwels' and 'meestal' in place.

laat_vaar.voor: Praat net so eerlik en met respek oor 'n ander groep se optrede.
laat_vaar.na: Praat net so eerlik en met respek oor 'n ander groep se optrede as oor julle s'n.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Net so' sets up a comparison that is never completed; naming the other half makes the sentence say what it means.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Anaphoric 'net so' is normal Afrikaans and clear from the preceding sentences; the addition costs four words near the ceiling and introduces 'julle s'n' (your performance) where the paragraph spoke of your songs.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Twee dinge om na te luister
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Sag teenoor hard is 'n kontras en hoog teenoor laag ook.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Sag teenoor hard is 'n kontras, en hoog teenoor laag is ook een.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The elliptical second clause reads clipped; giving it its own verb makes two full clauses, which then take the AWS comma before en.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The elliptical 'en hoog teenoor laag ook' is natural Afrikaans; 'is ook een' is heavier and only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: in plaas van om te sing
laat_vaar_vorige.na: in plaas daarvan om te sing
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Before an om te-infinitive the standard construction is 'in plaas daarvan om te'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'in plaas van om te sing' is accepted, natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral, more formal variant.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en speel baie groepe ook 'n baskitaar en tromme
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en baie groepe speel ook 'n baskitaar en tromme
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: After the comma the second clause stands on its own, and normal subject-verb order after 'en' reads more naturally than inversion carried over from 'Vandag'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The inversion after 'en' is correct, natural Afrikaans that carries 'Vandag' into both clauses; the proposal only reorders and loosens that link.
